typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		BASE_TABLE_NAME as string,
		CHILD_LEVEL as integer,
		NUMBER_OF_CHILD_TA as integer,
		PRINCIPAL_CLASS as string,
		BASE_LEVEL as integer,
		CHILD_TABLE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		BASE_TABLE_NAME as string,
		CHILD_LEVEL as integer,
		NUMBER_OF_CHILD_TA as integer,
		PRINCIPAL_CLASS as string,
		BASE_LEVEL as integer,
		CHILD_TABLE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		BASE_TABLE_NAME,
		CHILD_LEVEL,
		NUMBER_OF_CHILD_TA,
		PRINCIPAL_CLASS,
		BASE_LEVEL,
		CHILD_TABLE_NAME),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
